title: Goddess hand and palm-first onboarding
production_route: Camp New Game -> one-tree palm lesson -> sector 2 extinguisher and manual water -> remaining forest sectors

input.indicator: One crystal on the back of the LEFT rendered hand only; fill runs wrist-to-knuckles; bright at full charge.
input.aim: All five left fingers extended; tracked palmar normal intersects the miniature ground within ability range and island bounds. The blue circle shows the splash radius.
input.cast: Right hand relaxed and stacked across the left wrist/back, palms approximately parallel, for 0.12 seconds. Supporting near the wrist keeps the left fingertips exposed to headset cameras.
input.stop: Lift the right hand, curl the left fingers, leave the ground, lose tracking, enter a menu or acquire a tool. No charge is discarded on release.
input.ownership: Both hands must be free of weapons/nozzle/pump/station ownership. Aiming reserves the left hand; stacked casting reserves both against menu input.
input.desktop_equivalent: Mouse aims; hold SPACE for palm water. Desktop equivalence is used for actual projectile regression, not a claim of headset gesture acceptance.

resource.new_sector: Full magic charge, independent of weapon tank contents.
resource.partial_charge: Usable immediately; stopping and restarting never requires discarding remaining charge.
resource.manual_water: Hydrants, lever pumps, creek and refill assist cannot refill magic.
resource.pause: No recovery or consumption during focus loss, pause or modal/shop pauses; no catch-up after resuming.
resource.retry: Sector-entry magic level and cumulative consumption restored; initial sector charge restored.

upgrades.purchase: Supply phase only; deduct exact displayed price; increasing capacity does not immediately grant water.
upgrades.presentation: Dedicated magic shop page, animated two-hand preview, before/after stats, English/Chinese String Tables.

lesson.equipment: Rack, take-tool button and water stations hidden/disabled until sector 2.
lesson.teaching: Blue hands demonstrate open left palm, stacked right hand, water stream, ground circle, stop and crystal recovery.
lesson.forgiving: Lesson tree does not burn out or spread, sheep do not ignite while the player learns.
lesson.second_sector: Gold right-hand handle, cyan left-hand nozzle and squeeze-to-spray guidance.

weapon_recovery: Existing recovery retained for every equipped water weapon: 3 seconds idle, then 0.25 units/second. Manual collection remains far faster.

validation.domain: Five new regressions cover budget, pause/clamp, upgrade economy, checkpoint restore, one-tree lesson and tracked stack gesture gates.
validation.scene: Actual production New Game uses real WaterJet packets to save the tree with SPACE without spending weapon water; magic shop purchase and sector-2 tool unlock verified.
validation.fixtures: Editor-only BeginEquipmentTestRun preserves the old three-fire fixture for focused equipment/menu/refill regressions; production New Game always uses the palm tutorial.
validation.headset: Quest/PICO tracking ergonomics and occlusion still need worn-headset testing. No OS tracking guarantee.

status: QUEST_BUILT_AND_INSTALLED; 232 EditMode + 228 PlayMode passed; final 8 visual regressions passed; worn-headset acceptance pending
